selection.surface_rule: if match is preceded by a space, candidate is space+word; else the word; counted on Phase1G TRAIN text only
selection.keep_if: v0_7.encode(candidate) has length>=2 and candidate is not already a vocab string

initialization.embedding: mean of v0_7 piece embedding rows for tokenizer.encode(candidate)
initialization.lm_head_weight: mean of v0_7 piece language_head.weight rows
initialization.lm_head_bias: mean of v0_7 piece biases minus 8.0
initialization.justification: Mean piece embeddings/weights preserve decomposition. Bias shift -8 keeps new logits off the U0 argmax and limits softmax mass theft on the frozen 1024-way language stream until adaptation. Pure mean output would compete with first-piece logits at U0.

adaptation.trainable_scope: new embedding rows and new language_head rows/bias only; all original rows frozen
adaptation.dataset: new Phase1G TRAIN stream retokenized with v0_8_append64; historical u16 streams not overwritten
adaptation.optimizer: AdamW betas=(0.9,0.999) eps=1e-8 weight_decay=0.05 foreach=false fused=false
adaptation.scope_escalation: forbidden unless this protocol is amended
adaptation.pre_specified_failure: if shared-prefix exact does not improve materially vs 4.7% after this budget, stop; do not train old rows

u0_hard_stop.full_vocab_language_ce_may_shift: explained if new logits are finite; sliced CE is the old-token baseline

eval.native: greedy exact+EOS vs gold re-encoded with frozen extended tokenizer, plus v0_7-prompt expanded-head greedy vs v0_7 gold
eval.language_gates: sliced 1024-way DEV CE must remain within T24/T28 retention (min(1.30, u0+0.25) and gap<=0.5) on the original Phase1G DEV stream
eval.representation: pointer on unmodified v0_7 DEV encodings must match T28 terminal counts within 0 (frozen hidden path)
